subject: Action required: your store will be suspended in 24 hours
body:
Dear Merchant,

We were unable to process your most recent subscription payment. To avoid suspension of your store, please verify your billing details within 24 hours:

http://shopify-billing-support.co/verify-account

Failure to verify will result in permanent loss of store data.

Shopify Billing Department
needs_human_reason: Suspected phishing / security risk (rule 6). The owner should know the store is being targeted, and nobody should click the link.
summary: Fake 'Shopify Billing' suspension notice from lookalike domain shopify-billing-support.co with a 'verify account' link. Phishing; do not click, do not reply.
draft_reply: No reply - suspected phishing. The sender domain (shopify-billing-support.co) is not Shopify, and the email uses a 24-hour suspension threat, a generic 'Dear Merchant' greeting, and a link to 'verify billing details'. Do not click the link or reply. If there's any doubt about the Shopify bill, log in to Shopify directly (not through this email) and check billing there.
owner_note: Phishing attempt on the store's Shopify account. Delete it; consider warning the team so no one clicks.
